cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: Step 0 delivered: 56 specs and 112 plans from releases up to v1.8.9 moved into docs/superpowers/archive; release wrap-up had skipped this since v1.7.
impact: specs/ now holds only the accepted ADR-PD-001 and the v1.8.10 design doc; 23 navigational references updated; historical records (archive-index.json, release-train JSON evidence, devline records) keep their recorded paths.
lesson: Accepted ADRs are standing constraints, not version history: exclude them from release archiving and say so in the docs README.

cause: Extracting the inference kernel from the fitted object handed downstream gave the wrong covariance: run_ols returns the plain fit while the packet reports robust or clustered errors, and a survey design replaces the standard errors after the fit. Caught by a test comparing sqrt(diag(V)) with every reported standard error.
impact: Joint tests, lincom and margins would have used a variance different from the one on screen, silently, for robust, clustered and survey OLS.
lesson: A kernel must come from the computation that produced the reported standard errors; check it against every reported standard error, not against the fitted object.

cause: tests/test_evaluator_harness_manifest.py pinned an absolute path to the v173-evaluation-harness worktree, removed by the 2026-09-28 archive cleanup; the two tests also fail on v1.8.9.
impact: Two harness tests failed for an environmental reason, which a release gate would have reported as a regression.
lesson: Tests read commits through the repository they run in, never through an absolute worktree path.

cause: inspect_result_summary has an 8 KB output budget; the trimmer gave each nested level half its parent's room and dropped nested keys silently. Family evidence was the last key, so the CS interval and event study never reached the Agent, and the 1b test read the provider directly, bypassing the registry budget.
impact: In the browser the Agent told the user the CS confidence interval was 'not reported' and that no event study existed, while both were persisted.
lesson: Acceptance tests read results through the registered tool under its output budget, and any budget cut is named in the output.

cause: The CS and SA producers wrote the ATT coefficient row without the pointwise interval that cs_did.json / sa_did.json already carried.
impact: An Agent shown both copies reported the interval as missing.
lesson: Every persisted copy of one result carries the same inferential fields; a test compares them.

cause: The report writer's citable facts were built in the frontend from the graph and the coefficient row only.
impact: A generated report could cite the overall ATT but nothing of the event study the Agent could read.
lesson: Every AI consumer reads the declared family projection; run detail serves it and the fact table flattens it by shape.

cause: PANEL_POOLED_MODEL fires for CS DID although its influence function is entity-level and clustered by entity by default; result identity reports rows (120) and the packet reports units (12) both as n.
impact: The Agent recommended a clustered-OLS rerun that does not apply to CS and flagged an unexplained sample-size discrepancy.
lesson: Check applicability is declared by estimator traits; sample sizes name their unit.

cause: DeepSeek returns HTTP 402; the account balance is -0.01 CNY.
impact: Report generation and the ordinal/Cox Agent questions of the step-1 browser acceptance could not run; deterministic checks through the registered tools passed.
lesson: Live-model acceptance needs a provider balance check before the session starts.

cause: Step 1 (result envelope, inference kernel, number formatting, collection envelope) accepted in the browser after the provider balance was restored.
impact: Agent, report writer, Table view and report regression table quote the same CS, ordinal and Cox numbers; full backend suite 5906 passed in 14:12. Deviation: full covariance stored up to 300 parameters, not 500.
lesson: Live acceptance reruns in a fresh Agent session; an earlier session's tool output stays in its history.

cause: The run contract summary records the default covariance 'robust' for a logit fit, which is estimated with model-based variance; the summary records the requested default, not what executed.
impact: In the browser the Agent warned twice that the post-estimation used a non-robust covariance while the model claims robust; the provenance misstates what ran.
lesson: Provenance records the estimator that executed, read from the kernel, not the default that was requested.

cause: Selecting a model node of another run in the graph left the Agent session bound to the previous run's model node.
impact: The Agent answered about the OLS node while the user had selected the ordinal logit node; reproduced again for step 8 (FocusRef).
lesson: The Agent's focus is the selected node, resolved through FocusRef, not the run the page was opened on.

cause: Post-estimation on the inference kernel: Wald, lincom, nlcom, LR and marginal effects, offered per family only with R oracle data, reachable as read-only workflow steps.
impact: Four browser scenarios passed with DeepSeek; results match R (car, lmtest, marginaleffects). Open decision for the user: robust and clustered OLS report z, Stata reports t; model.joint_f_test stays refit-based until that is decided.
lesson: Oracle conventions must match the target reference: R's glm reports expected information, Stata and statsmodels observed information; for non-canonical links the oracle uses the observed one.

cause: User decision (2026-10-02): robust and clustered OLS adopt Stata's finite-sample rules, t(N-K)/F(q,N-K) and t(G-1)/F(q,G-1), with one inference context for coefficients, intervals and joint tests; results computed before are versioned, not rewritten.
impact: Default OLS (HC1) p-values and intervals change for new runs; HC1 and CR1 variances were already Stata's. Joint F test now reads the kernel. Full backend suite 6024 passed (13:10). Moving the joint test onto the kernel exposed an absolute rank tolerance in post-estimation, fixed.
lesson: Degrees of freedom are a property of the estimator's inference context, recorded with the result, never computed by the consumer.

cause: Building the check context read linearmodels' fitted object as if it were statsmodels' outside the runner's exception guard, so the first full suite showed every IV run failing.
impact: A check library added for honesty made a whole family's runs fail; caught by the full suite before commit.
lesson: Everything a check needs is gathered inside the same guard that turns failures into 'not checked'; a check never fails the run.

cause: The browser acceptance showed the report printing a Breusch-Pagan statistic on the zero residuals of a perfect fit, and the IV card calling F = 101.6 strong, beside check results saying the opposite.
impact: Two consumers of the same fit disagreed in the product; deterministic tests read only the new artifacts.
lesson: When a new authority for a judgement is added, every older display of that judgement reads from it or is withdrawn; walk every surface that showed the old one.

cause: Separation is checked by linear programming for binary outcomes against detectseparation; no validated definition is implemented for ordinal or multinomial outcomes.
impact: Ordinal and multinomial fits report separation as 'not checked' rather than checked.
lesson: Extend a check only with a validated definition and an oracle; until then say 'not checked'.

cause: Traits, check library (10 checks), Anderson-Rubin set, admission kit and three known fixes delivered; browser acceptance passed without LLM calls.
impact: Backend 6064 passed (13:49), frontend 1730 passed. Deviation: the family admission gap list is in the step-3 plan appendix, not the frozen objective. Three families fully admitted; 17 gaps planned for v1.8.11.
lesson: Synthetic test data that is an exact formula is a perfect fit; new honesty checks will flag it, which is correct.

cause: P7 branch tests ported per Codex's file-by-file review: 22 as-is, one rewritten for the current matching contract, one renamed, one not ported (covered), two never-comparing placeholders dropped.
impact: 314 ported tests pass with no skip; full backend 6378 passed (13:31). No code defect surfaced; the admission gap list is unchanged (the oracles cover analysis packs, not model families).
lesson: A test that skips unconditionally, or checks only that a script exists, is not evidence; port the comparison, not the placeholder.

cause: Multiple imputation pooled by Rubin's rules with Barnard-Rubin df on inference kernels; offered for oracle-checked (family, covariance) pairs only.
impact: Matches R mice::pool to 1e-7 on fixtures and 10 digits on the real-data acceptance run; both browser scenarios pass; full backend 6406 passed; 10k rows m=20 in 6.3 s.
lesson: Leave out any packet field that differs across the m fits instead of listing single-dataset fields per family.

cause: Browser acceptance: the Global Agent reads inspect_project_model_coefficients and the overview label, not inspect_result_summary which was the one updated; it could not tell the result was pooled nor why a joint test was unavailable. Also the MI offer was worded 'default covariance' while the Agent's vocabulary is unadjusted/robust/clustered (product OLS default is robust), and the Notebook materialization allowlist refused a field planning had accepted.
impact: All three would have shipped with green tests; each blocked or misled the Agent in the real path.
lesson: When adding a field to results, enumerate every projection the Agent reads (result summary, project coefficient tool, overview label) and test them together; write offers in the request's own vocabulary; planning and materialization must share one field list.

cause: HAC (Newey-West) standard errors for OLS as an option-contract covariance with a declared time order.
impact: Matches R sandwich at 1e-9 and Stata newey/test live; three browser scenarios pass on Seatbelts; full backend 6422 passed after updating two pinned planner-catalog expectations.
lesson: Align the named method's defaults across implementations before writing the oracle (R NeweyWest prewhites by default; Stata reads CSV as float without asdouble); a new result type must be added to every variant list, and the family-literal ratchet should push those lists toward declared properties.

cause: With a declared survey subpopulation the OLS packet kept the full-sample WLS coefficients while the standard errors came from the design engine's subpopulation fit (since v1.8.7); fit statistics also described every row.
impact: Any single run with survey_subpop reported wrong coefficients next to correct SEs; found by comparing with Stata svy, subpop() while building domain estimation.
lesson: When one engine replaces part of a result (the variance), check that every number beside it describes the same sample; compare the whole row with a reference, not only the replaced column.

cause: Notebook planning validated only family fields of model_params, while materialization refused any unknown key; the Agent put workflow-style branches into a single-model option and the failure surfaced only after the user confirmed. Same class as the step 5 multiple_imputations gap.
impact: A confirmed option failed to materialize; fixed by one shared allowlist (NOTEBOOK_GENESIS_MODEL_PARAMS) used by both, plus by-group expected artifacts and draft schema.
lesson: One field list, imported by every layer that checks the same payload; a second hand-written list is a future refusal after confirmation.

cause: By-group combinator for models and named tests with subset/domain semantics, invariance test, group-difference Wald, cross-group adjustment, ledger counts, Agent grounding check.
impact: R and Stata oracles agree; browser scenarios pass on SLID; full backend 6458 passed (14:38).
lesson: Derive per-run counts (groups estimated) at disclosure time from the run's own artifacts, so every submission path counts alike.

cause: Focus context: one FocusRef resolved by a provider registry (project, dataset, node, plan, report); a graph selection resolves to the run that owns the node; the Data page declares its dataset; session creation carries the focus to the backend.
impact: Browser scenarios 1-4 pass on iv_returns_to_schooling (dataset focus runs read-only descriptives; node in another run binds to that run). Full backend 6458 passed, frontend 1741 passed, tsc clean.
lesson: Decide between two competing UI signals (run switch vs node selection) by which changed last, not by a fixed precedence.

cause: Survey results kept the pre-design fit's covariance evidence (HC1, t(N-K)) that the table view and Agent read, and the step 7 Korn-Graubard F took degf-p+1 as d. Found while implementing the user's df decision (design df default, R convention optional).
impact: Since v1.8.7 a survey run was described as HC1 t(77) beside design SEs on t(6); the group-difference F differed slightly from Stata (only W had been compared). Now F, df and p match Stata live; R convention matches R oracle.
lesson: Compare the reported test statistic, df and p with the oracle, not an intermediate quantity like W; and when one engine replaces variance, every reader of inference metadata must read the replacement.

cause: Codex Evaluation Lane (branch eval/v1810-codex, 9ce17129) ran 14 adversarial checks on steps 5-8: 10 passed, 4 failed. A03 (MI + by_group silently dropped grouping on direct runs), A04 (null r_squared in pooled projections), A14 (focus on non-existent run) fixed; A01 judged not a defect (R glm variance at previous IRLS iterate, p-value rel diff 1.4e-7 under 1e-6 convention).
impact: One silent-drop defect reachable through HTTP/CLI though the Agent planner refused it. Codex tests were not cherry-picked: integration of the evaluation branch was blocked pending user approval; equivalent regression tests written in-branch. Perf budgets measured: design checks 0.05s, logit+separation 0.72s, by-group 10 groups +2.2s.
lesson: A refusal enforced in the Agent planner must also be enforced in the pipeline; every entry point (HTTP, CLI, Agent) reaches the same stage.

cause: Host full gate (scripts/gate.sh --full) on 481fe288, after the Codex evaluation fixes; Vite stopped, machine to itself.
impact: GATE PASSED: backend 6497 passed / 5 skipped / 1 xfailed in 16:07; golden/invariants/snapshot 23 passed; frontend 208 files / 1746 tests passed; tsc clean.
lesson: Do not edit the working tree while the gate runs; the first v1.8.10 gate was voided because reference data changed mid-run.

cause: User approved merging and tagging v1.8.10 after the host gate on 481fe288.
impact: workbench-v1.8.10 merged into main (b38740ec, --no-ff), tagged v1.8.10, pushed; GitHub Release created. These release events were recorded at v1.8.11 kickoff because the devline append was blocked by a permission rule during the release.
lesson: Record GATE and RELEASED devline events in the release session, before the next version starts.
